{"sourceType":"Non ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/nonEsaTenderActions/filter/open","id":2037,"idEra":1287,"activityNumber":"","contractNumber":"4000125901","tanumber":"21.CLOU.001","title":"EO Network of Resources - Best Practices ITT to procure services from resource and platform tier providers","description":"Exploitation Platforms are a central element of ESA's Earth Observation (EO) Innovation Europe concept, which aims at the integration of EO data and information for a much broader use, for scientific, social and economic purposes, as well as for the generation of new commercial applications and services. 

The EO Network of Resources (NoR) initiative promotes the use of European resource and platform services to facilitate a simplified and efficient exploitation of EO data in cloud environments. The initiative incentivizes providers to contribute to a common framework harmonising the access to their services and helping the user to work with the data.

ESA conducted an ITT (AO/1-9217/18/I-LG-Procurement of Earth Observation Exploitation Platform Network Resource Services) in 2018. The tender awarded a contract in December 2018 to Cloudeo AG as prime to select under the supervision of ESA, and via ESA’s Best Practices Processes, the services of eligible Resource and Platform Tier Providers.

A NoR portal (https://nor-discover.cloudeo.group) lists in an online directory all the onboarded providers together with their NoR service portfolio. ESA can sponsor or co-fund scientists and value adding users for eligible research, development and pre-commercial projects.
